tools.name: find_skills
tools.description: Find recommended installed skills for a task in plain words. Use explain to see matching terms and weak matches. Use load_skill only for a recommended result. If the result contains a clarification question, repeat the search with more details. Set browse to true to skip the match count check. Suppl

tools.name: load_skill
tools.description: Load the instructions of one skill. Use an id from find_skills. Returns the skill text, its source, and its file list.

tools.name: read_skill_file
tools.description: Read one file inside a skill directory. Use a path from the file list that load_skill returns.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "find_skills" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
